description: Source code for STM32F4 microcontroller handling SPI communication, UART, GPIO configuration, and interrupt handling for a specific hardware setup involving SPI2 and USART3.

methods.name: uart_putc
methods.description: Send a character over UART by placing it into the transmit buffer and enabling transmit interrupt.

methods.name: uart_getc
methods.description: Retrieve a character from UART receive buffer, returns NO_DATA if buffer is empty.

methods.name: spi
methods.description: Perform SPI transfer by toggling chip select and reading/writing data register.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing hardware peripherals, performing initial SPI communication, and entering an infinite loop to toggle GPIOs and send SPI commands.

methods.name: USART3_IRQHandler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for USART3, managing receive and transmit buffers.
